answer: Escrowed sybil bounty turns each farm member into a reporter. Each identity locks 80 copper in key-bound escrow for its voyage to payout; the bond cannot be reused. A reporter proving two identities share one operator takes 32 copper, 40% of the slashed bond, and the rest burns. Silence costs each member that 32 copper bounty, so the k-th fake costs 112 copper, and the silence bill is a spiral, each member adding another claimant. A thousand fakes cost 112,000 copper. An honest agent pays 80 once. Renting a bond fails: proof names the key, so it burns the renter's stake.
